title: Dispatch parallel jobs across multiple working models
goal: Build a production scheduler that dispatches independent ready jobs simultaneously across multiple currently working credential/model targets, rather than using all models solely as serial fallbacks. Use fresh actual inference availability and task-class evidence; preserve capability, tool grants, privacy, deadlines and budgets. Distinct model IDs sharing a provider/account are not independent quota pools. Admit bounded concurrency, queue excess work fairly, and fall back per job if a target fails. Hermetic dispatch tests prove overlapping real execution on at least three fake working models and skip higher-ranked nonworking models. Implement nonzero tests named parallel_working_models_* in the production owning crate.
